newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Bank of Ireland applies for NYSE listing.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Ireland applies for NYSE listing.

text.p: Bank of Ireland said on Monday that it had submitted a listing application to the New York Stock Exchange and expects trading in its American Depositary Recipts (ADRs) to begin on September 17.
This follows the establishment of a sponsored Level One ADR programme in November 1995, Bank of Ireland said in a statement.

"This is a welcome development for Bank of Ireland. Listing on the New York Stock Exchange confirms and enhances the status of our stock and will facilitate more active international trading," chief executive Pat Molloy said.
